subject: Bellini & Co. pilot invoice
body: Francesca, Bellini & Co. Avvocati has not paid the pilot invoice INV-2026-014 for EUR 4,800: it is 21 days overdue today. I called their office manager this morning and agreed a payment plan: EUR 2,400 by 28 November and EUR 2,400 by 13 December. I'll follow up on the first instalment. Marta
